subject.title: feat(bedrock): enable prompt caching for Nova models

question: Should Nova prompt-cache eligibility use the existing `ProviderPlugin.isCacheTtlEligible` contract, or should OpenClaw intentionally add `compat.supportsCacheRetention` as a second exported model capability?
rationale: Both choices affect the public plugin contract and permanent ownership boundary; automation should not establish a parallel provider API without maintainer intent.

options.title: Reuse the existing hook
options.body: Implement Nova eligibility through `isCacheTtlEligible`, remove the parallel compat flag, and keep one provider-owned source of truth.

options.title: Approve the new capability
options.body: Keep `supportsCacheRetention` only with explicit API rationale, compatibility documentation, and tests defining precedence against `isCacheTtlEligible`.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open until the API direction and credentialed AWS proof are available.

recommendation.title: Reuse the existing hook
recommendation.body: Implement Nova eligibility through `isCacheTtlEligible`, remove the parallel compat flag, and keep one provider-owned source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history is closest to the shared cache-retention contract and Bedrock pass-through behavior affected by this API choice.
